sampling: Exclude all 200 candidates from natural-repetition-v1, then order the remaining HotpotQA validation IDs by SHA256([seed,id]); first 64 candidates, first 8 passing complete-context tokenizer eligibility. No label or outcome selection.
limits: Interface engineering diagnostic, not method validation or evidence of DICE efficacy.
Prompt revision bundles literal ID clarification and an explicit empty-answer example; it does not isolate their individual effects.
Original generic JSON uses the existing server default; guided JSON explicitly uses Outlines with fallback disabled. This compares decoding stacks, not schema alone.
The installed vLLM 0.8.3 rejects xgrammar schemas containing enum or maxItems before generation. Outlines is chosen prospectively, not silently substituted after a failed experimental call.
Visible-ID membership is not evidential support. Schema validity does not enforce UTF-8 byte count or factual answer correctness.
Invalid complete outputs score zero; failed or pending infrastructure calls block full scoring. No repairs, retries, truncation, effect-based stopping or automatic next batch.
Eight questions are the independent units, not 64 calls; intervals are descriptive and unadjusted. Fresh from our prior candidate frame does not mean absent from model pretraining.
